packwork.handbook.title: Outfitter's Handbook
packwork.handbook.hint: Right-click to read it. Six chapters, no crafting required.
packwork.handbook.report: Bugs and ideas: github.com/SapperSquad/Packwork/issues, or the Discord.
packwork.jei.pack.info: A humble adventurer's pack that sorts itself. Stamped leather tabs are compartments; a rules engine files each item the moment it lands, and a Loose tab catches the rest so nothing is ever lost. Right-click to open, or sneak-click a block face to set it down. Craft it up the tiers, then fit trinkets for magnet, repair, restock, and the fluid/XP/charge stores.
packwork.jei.pack.tier: This tier: %s compartment slots, %s trinket sockets.
packwork.jei.trinket.header: Pack fitting - slot it into a trinket socket:
packwork.jei.handbook.info: The in-house guide. Right-click to open six chapters on sorting, trinkets, tiers, the stores, and where to send a field report.
packwork.jei.upgrade.preserves: Everything inside carries up: contents, compartments, pins, trinkets, name, and every store.
packwork.trinket.install_hint: Slot it into a pack's trinket socket to fit it.
packwork.trinket.waterskin_rack.desc: Fits a fluid tank to the pack - a rack of waterskins.
packwork.trinket.soul_vial.desc: Stores XP, and auto-mends your Mending gear from it.
packwork.trinket.charge_crystal.desc: Holds an arcane charge and tops up the tools in your hands.
packwork.trinket.flask_harness.desc: A rack of alchemist's flasks for bottled vapors - a chemical tank (needs Mekanism).
packwork.trinket.lodestone_charm.desc: Draws loose items nearby into the pack - and files what you mine: pickups the pack can sort go straight in. New finds still go to your pockets.
packwork.trinket.compass_rose.desc: Voids items you mark - the only way a pack throws anything away.
packwork.trinket.restock_strap.desc: Tops up your hotbar stacks from pack stock.
packwork.trinket.bottomless_lining.desc: Adds another run of slots to the pack.
packwork.trinket.repair_kit.desc: Slowly mends the gear you're wearing and holding.
packwork.trinket.quick_draw_straps.desc: When a tool breaks in your hand, the pack passes you another from stock.
packwork.trinket.quill_and_ledger.desc: Unlocks the rule editor: write your own filters (name, mod, category) on any custom compartment, and they sort while it's fitted. Stamps and pins work without it.
packwork.trinket.tinkers_kit.desc: A tool roll that unrolls inside the pack: a 3x3 bench fed straight from your stores.
packwork.trinket.field_furnace.desc: Banked embers that cook raw ore and raw food as you walk. Feed it fuel from the pack.
packwork.trinket.provisioners_pouch.desc: Feeds you the cheapest safe thing in the pack before hunger bites. Your golden apples stay yours.
packwork.trinket.cartographers_sleeve.de: Adds a Charts compartment: maps, compasses, clocks and the spyglass, filed on their own.
packwork.trinket.anglers_creel.desc: Your catch lands in the pack, in a Catch compartment of its own.
packwork.trinket.torchbearers_loop.desc: Sets a torch down from pack stock when you're standing in the dark.
packwork.trinket.herbalists_bundle.desc: Replants a grown crop the moment you pull it, using a seed from your own stock.
packwork.pack.hint: Right-click to open. It sorts itself.
packwork.ui.loose_hint: Anything no rule claims ends up here, so nothing is ever lost.
packwork.ui.tab_pin_hint: Drop an item in to pin it here - it stays put. Hover and press P works too.
packwork.ui.tab_edit_hint: Right-click: remove - Middle-click: dye - R: rename - I: stamp icon - [ ]: reorder
packwork.ui.tank_hint: Click with a bucket or flask to fill or empty it.
packwork.ui.vial_hint: Click to siphon your XP in - Shift-click to pour it back.
packwork.ui.crystal_hint: Fills from any charger; tops up the tools in your hands.
packwork.ui.flask_hint: Bottled vapors - any Mekanism chemical pipe fills it.
packwork.ui.ledger_btn_hint: Everything craftable from pack stock, on one parchment.
packwork.ui.ledger_empty: Nothing craftable from stock. Fill the pack and look again.
packwork.ui.ledger_chalk: Click to chalk it onto the roll.
packwork.ui.ledger_unchalk: Chalked. Click again to wipe it off.
packwork.ui.ghost_hint: Click the result well to lay it out from stock.
packwork.ui.roll_hint: Shift-click from the pack to lay one item on the bench. Each cell tops itself back up from your stores after every craft; roll up and it all goes home.
packwork.ui.pin_key: [%s] Keep in this tab - auto-sort won't move it
packwork.ui.unpin_key: [%s] Pinned here - press it again to release
packwork.ui.pinned_note: Pinned %s to %s - auto-sort won't move it
packwork.ui.unpinned_note: Released %s - the pack files it where it belongs
packwork.ui.pickup_on_hint: What the pack can file - sorted, pinned, or already aboard - goes straight in as you pick it up. New finds still go to your pockets. Click to turn off.
packwork.ui.pickup_off_hint: Everything you pick up goes to your pockets, like vanilla. Click to send what the pack can file straight in.
packwork.ui.mode_btn_tidy_hint: Click to keep your own layout: items stay in the cells you drop them, and new arrivals fill the gaps.
packwork.ui.mode_btn_keep_hint: Items stay where you put them; new arrivals fill gaps; Tidy Up still re-sorts once. Click to let the pack tidy this compartment again.
packwork.ui.rules_btn_hint: The Quill & Ledger's desk: filters by name, mod, or category.
packwork.ui.rules_stamp_hint: Always on, ledger or no. Hover an item and press I to restamp the tab.
packwork.ui.rules_empty: No written rules yet. Type below, or press a category.
